class.name: eys3d_camera/CameraNodelet
class.description: Driver for eYs3D stereo depth cameras (G100+, R77, G62). Publishes color, depth, and point cloud topics with a REP-103 frame tree, and exposes runtime stream control, depth post-processing, and in-stream self-calibration. Load it into a shared nodelet manager to hand frames to downstream nodelets without serialising them.
